scientific_facts_for_ui.fact_1: Measurements from the MEDA station on the Perseverance rover show that temperatures in Jezero Crater drop to -85°C at night.
scientific_facts_for_ui.fact_2: Batteries and water pipes in Mars bases require continuous heating and thermal insulation to prevent fluid freezing and power loss.
